name: Benén
text: Benén appears in the record as Beanán and under the Latin name Benignus. He was a saint whose life ran close to St Patrick. He served the great missionary as companion and as the one who chanted the psalms. The Church keeps his memorial on 9 November each year. His name carries a sense of mildness drawn from the Latin stem for kindly.

attributes.attribute: a saint and companion of St Patrick
name echoes a Latin word meaning kind

okr.objective: Tell who Benén was beside the Irish mission.
key_results: Benén was a saint who accompanied St Patrick.
He acted as the missionary's psalm-chanter.
His name recalls a Latin word for a kindly manner.
